title: 2024 Bowman #17 Jasson Dominguez Yankees Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
Own a piece of baseball history with this 2024 Bowman sports trading card featuring Jasson Dominguez, a rookie player for the New York Yankees. This card is part of the base set and has the card number #17. It is an original and licensed reprint by Bowman, a reputable manufacturer in the industry. 

This card is perfect for collectors who are fans of the Major League (MLB) and the Yankees. It is a great addition to any collection of sports trading cards. Don't miss the opportunity to own this unique piece of memorabilia.
